By Stephen Walt @ForeignPolicy
foreignpolicy.com/2026/05/28…

I joined @democracynow with Amy Goodman and Juan González to discuss the U.S.-Iran peace talks, the shaky ceasefire, and the path toward ending the war on Iran.

VIDEO: piped.video/KQCbBN_tBMk?si=pRNy…

I told @BBCWorld that the U.S. and Iran are very close to a peace deal. Main points are: permanent end to the regional war, mutual reopening of Hormuz, economic relief for Iran, and eventually a nuclear agreement.

The challenge is trust. There is very little of it on either side, which means diplomacy could unravel at any moment.

Video

What will Iran do with the Strait of Hormuz?

I told @Channel4News there’s active debate in Iran over how the Strait should be managed moving forward, in both war and peace.
